# MongoDB explain plans, query planner and plan cache — concept pack

> MongoDB explain output (queryPlanner, executionStats, allPlansExecution) details the plan the query optimizer selected and how it ran; the plan cache, query shapes with $queryStats, query settings and hint() steer or bypass that choice, and the database profiler, the slow query log and $indexStats measure what indexes actually did. Compiled from MongoDB manual, Atlas and Compass pages plus the run's verified claims; facets cover definitions, mechanisms, how-tos, problems and version changes.
